description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Pie', which implements a 2D pie chart plotting utility with features like exploding slices, setting diameter, starting angle, and grouping small slices as 'the rest'. It includes methods for drawing the pie chart, legend samples, and marker data.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Pie
classes.description: A class for rendering 2D pie charts with features like exploding slices, custom diameter, starting angle, and grouping small slices as 'the rest'.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample pie slice for the legend.

methods.name: _getMarkerData
methods.description: Calculates marker point data for a given point, including angle and position.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws markers on the canvas for pie slices.

methods.name: explode
methods.description: Explodes a pie slice by a specified radius, optionally for a specific x value.

methods.name: setStartingAngle
methods.description: Sets the starting angle and direction (clockwise or counterclockwise) for the pie chart.

methods.name: setDiameter
methods.description: Sets the diameter of the pie chart in pixels.

methods.name: setRestGroup
methods.description: Sets the limit below which slices are grouped as 'the rest' and the title for that group.

methods.name: _getDiameter
methods.description: Calculates and returns the diameter of the pie chart based on settings and canvas size.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the pie chart slices onto the canvas, including handling of 'rest' group and marker drawing.

methods.name: _legendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample pie slice for the legend display.
